instruction: Candid office photograph, medium shot. In a modern office, the young Black man in a white dress shirt and maroon trousers (R1) stands on the left, facing right and looking at his colleague. The older bearded man in a dark gray suit (R2) stands on the right, facing left in profile. They stand on opposite sides of a wooden desk and clasp right hands in a firm handshake. The background features office shelves with plants, and a green snake plant sits in the foreground. Soft, natural indoor lighting illuminates the scene, creating a professional and welcoming atmosphere.
